latest_evidence.probe: Test whether one O(1)-active-state retained predecessor digest/hash-chain anchor can mechanically detect authoritative-ref rewrite or terminal deletion without protected/admin retention.
latest_evidence.result: FALSIFIED_UNCONDITIONALLY; CONDITIONAL_DETECTION_ONLY. Same-ref rollback can erase both terminal and co-resident anchor, making created-then-rewritten observationally identical to never-created. A surviving prior snapshot SHA plus retained digest can detect the first divergence and fail closed, but only if the anchor and snapshot survive independently; detection does not prevent deletion.
latest_evidence.source_basis: Public GitHub REST docs: refs may be updated to a supplied SHA with force semantics; commits may be read by commit SHA. No immutable-ref or indefinite unreachable-object-retention guarantee was assumed.
latest_evidence.tested_scope: One bounded CLEAN architecture/information-flow falsification over one terminal, one retained predecessor anchor, one destructive rewrite/removal, and one later recurrence; own r269 state plus public GitHub docs only; no O/downstream/other-worker semantics, protected authority, hosted compute/storage add-ons, external model/API execution, finite quota, manual execution, scheduler mutation, same-run retry, or optional second leaf.

candidate_comparison.per_effect_witness_or_anchor: stronger but growing or externally reconstructible evidence still needs retention

latest_evidence.conflict_check: Exactly one bounded CLEAN Phase-1 child; exact-blob two-pass authority matched and only own role-local state/receipt namespaces were mutated.

frontier: r269 monotonic terminal-retention remains necessary when all evidence shares the rewrite domain.
O(1) hashing compresses evidence but cannot preserve it through rollback of the hash root itself.
A surviving prior snapshot SHA plus one retained digest detects first divergence conditionally and must fail closed on loss of the anchor/snapshot.
Exact duplicate/no-silent-loss safety remains conditional on at least one evidence channel being monotonic relative to the destructive rewrite.
